purpose: Benchmark models with reproducible datasets and explicit uncertainty.

trigger: Benchmark these language models on GSM8K and MMLU
Evaluate my fine-tuned model with lm-eval
Compare runs of model accuracy across snapshots
do_not_trigger: Judge writing style without running a benchmark

preflight: Pin model, tokenizer, dataset revision and evaluator versions.
Verify dataset license, prompt templates and deterministic decoding settings.
Record hardware, sample counts and resource budgets.
workflow: Run a small dry-run then the agreed benchmark subset.
Capture raw per-task counts and task configuration.
Compare uncertainty, seeds and contamination limitations.
Store machine-readable results and exact provenance.

evidence.how_to_verify: Record dataset/task hashes, model and decoding parameters.
Retain raw numeric results and sample counts, not narrative alone.
Pin evaluator, model and dataset versions and result artifact hash.

failure_modes: Do not claim comparable rankings from different task templates or subsets.
On OOM or interrupted runs, mark incomplete counts and resume only verified shards.
